title: Rule 11’s safe-harbor procedure
summary: The safe-harbor mechanism gives a party an opportunity to withdraw or correct challenged material before an opponent’s Rule 11 motion is filed with the court. It is a procedural condition on that route to sanctions.
notes: Different sanctions mechanisms have different procedures. The full rule and its exceptions are in the supplement on file (Rule 11, PDF page 31), linked below; a general allegation of bad faith does not excuse identifying the correct authority.

sections.Meaning: The safe-harbor mechanism gives a party an opportunity to withdraw or correct challenged material before an opponent’s Rule 11 motion is filed with the court. It is a procedural condition on that route to sanctions.
sections.How to work through the question: Identify whether sanctions are sought by a party’s motion or another authority, whether the motion was properly separated and served, and whether the required opportunity to correct was provided. Hadges illustrates why these conditions matter.
